items.title: Truelayer and Papa John’s transact AI-powered agentic Pay by Bank payment
items.why: Agent-initiated bank payments are live in the UK; watch whether this pressures card rails in the US.
items.summary_ai: Truelayer and Lloyds Bank completed an AI agent-initiated pay-by-bank payment at Papa John's in the UK.
items.take: Agent-initiated bank payments are live in the UK; watch whether this pressures card rails in the US.
